parameters.name: BackupPlanId
parameters.description: Backup plan ID. Obtain this parameter's value by calling the [DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~) API.

parameters.name: BackupRetentionPeriod
parameters.description:
Backup data retention period, in days. Valid values: 0 to 1825.

> Default value: 730 days.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: An arbitrary string used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions.

parameters.name: DuplicationArchivePeriod
parameters.description:
Time to convert to Archive Storage. This value must be less than the backup data retention period (BackupRetentionPeriod parameter). For more information about Archive Storage, see [Storage Type Overview](~~51374~~).

> Default value: 365 days.

parameters.name: DuplicationInfrequentAccessPeriod
parameters.description:
Time to convert to Infrequent Access storage. This value must be less than the Archive Storage period (DuplicationArchivePeriod parameter). For more information about Infrequent Access storage, see [Storage Type Overview](~~51374~~).

> Default value: 180 days.
